environment.working_tree: untracked ERP implementation docs; no production code changes

decisions.summary: Active organization membership and Platform permissions are the authorization source.
Use existing owner/admin/agent/viewer roles, not new ERP roles.
catalog.read and catalog.manage are the target read/manage permissions; local catalog.write mismatch remains.
Enforce authorization server-side and through database policies, not UI visibility alone.
Organization is the initial Products access boundary.
Products and categories are organization-wide; workspace-specific product authorization is outside the target scope.
No record-assignee/team ACL exists in the current Products domain.
Hard delete, exports and sensitive commercial fields need explicit policy.
Shared Platform collaboration and Document Intelligence permissions are reused and inherit referenced-record access.
Membership and role grants remain Platform organization-management actions.

actions: Inspected organization role/permission grants and active-membership authorization.

Reviewed organization/workspace policy patterns and legacy role-vocabulary drift.
Defined a role/action/scope matrix, sensitive-data policy, audit requirements and RLS requirements.
Enumerated required authorization, tenant-isolation, bulk, export, attachment and replay tests.
